cards.back: Always 0. Zero groups, or groups of nothing, leave nothing.
cards.say: Any number times zero. Always zero. Zero groups, or groups of nothing, leave nothing.
Any number times one. The number stays the same. Nine times one equals nine.

cards.back: The digits of each answer up to 9 × 10 add up to 9. Example: 9 × 7 = 63 and 6 + 3 = 9.
cards.say: Nine times table trick. The digits of each answer up to nine times ten add up to nine. Example: nine times seven equals sixty three and six plus three equals nine.
